chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his early 30s, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman, late 20s, wearing a light pink hijab and a long lilac house kaftan
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her late 30s, long wavy hennaed hair, big gold hoop earrings, wearing a leopard-print blouse

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca apartment living room, evening. WIFE sits on a sofa giggling secretly at her phone, hiding the screen with her hand; NARRATOR stands in the doorway behind her holding a packed suitcase, frowning suspiciously. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Bedroom in a Casablanca apartment. NARRATOR folds clothes into an open suitcase on the bed, looking thoughtful and worried, glancing at the door.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, home office corner. NARRATOR secretly holds his wife's smartphone up to his laptop webcam to scan a QR code, looking over his shoulder nervously, sneaky expression.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Small rented room far from home at night, lit only by a laptop. NARRATOR sits on a narrow bed with the laptop on his knees, leaning in, eyes wide and shocked, hand over his mouth.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SISTER lounges on a sofa in her own living room, typing on her smartphone with a sly scheming smile, one eyebrow raised, as if plotting something.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Video call feeling: SISTER, sly and excited, holds up her phone toward the viewer showing a photo of a big tough bald man with tattoos; WIFE on the other side of a split frame looks at her own phone curious and hesitant. Two people, faces visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE lies on the sofa in her living room texting nonstop on her phone, laughing loudly, cushions around her, tea glass forgotten on the table, a clock on the wall showing late hour.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone at a small table in a dim rented room, laptop open, his face hurt and angry, fists clenched, jaw tight, staring at the screen.
